headline: Humanoid robot beats human half-marathon record in Beijing
body: A quiet day with one striking image. A humanoid robot won Beijing's humanoid half marathon faster than the human world record, a year after most robots in the first race struggled. Fast progress like this lifts Capability Velocity, giving small boosts to endings that need very capable AI, such as Enslaved God and Descendants, and nudging Reversion and 1984 down. Horizon Balance is unchanged at +3.40.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.1 and Descendants +0.1 from the robot half-marathon win (+0.11 each), with Reversion -0.1 (-0.11).
